title: Windows team-matrix-e2e test 67 fails intermittently on main with a passing re-run
observation: The Windows platform-matrix-safety job failed on 'not ok 67 - team Matrix: three isolated clones share live memory, catch a bad branch, repair it, and never leak it publicly' for the second time on main. First sighting: main 6733f6cc ('policy pol_77f20b999a not found'), later runs passed. Second sighting: main CI run 35458134882 attempt 1 on f909958e (the v1.39.3 release merge) on 2026-09-19; attempt 2 of the same run on the same commit passed with no code change. The same job passed in the tagged Release run for that commit. A failure that clears on re-run of an identical tree is a flake, most likely an ordering or timing dependence in the multi-clone policy lookup on Windows; the cause has not been investigated.
